title: RELOAD DONE ALWAYS SOUNDS
why: His order of 2026-10-13: the reload done sound has to play always. Since the gun-by-gun reload sounds of v25.52 the closing step (the rack, the pump, the bolt) played only when the gun had been empty, so a reload with a round still in the chamber finished in silence. Now the short click and thud of the original reload cue plays on every finished reload, tactical or empty, every gun class, once, after the last step of the gun itself. A reload cut short by a swap, a roll, a sprint or going down plays nothing, as before. Sound only: no reload time or ammo changes.
now: Every finished reload now ends with a short click and thud, tactical or empty.

edits.anchor: if(!G.sim){ if(fx) rlfxPlay(1); else blipMine('reloadin'); }   // v10.56: the bolt goes home; v25.52: the last step of the gun (the rack only when it was empty)
